VERDICT: ACCEPT
Pass 1 inspected HEAD 2af1b3404df59a89190e47cf33d352e5e7adc58d and the full diff from 1c6397c740d9b64fab471a40f493c6f6acd10bcc: AC-3 satisfied (src/math.mjs:68-78 implements max minus min and singleton zero; test/math.test.mjs:85-90 checks both examples); R-1 satisfied (src/math.mjs:69-71 validates array shape, emptiness and finite numeric elements); R-2 satisfied (src/math.mjs:72-78 only reads input); R-3 satisfied (full diff preserves src/math.mjs:1-66 and every existing test except the permitted import at test/math.test.mjs:3); R-4 satisfied (only the two source/test paths changed, with package.json unchanged and no dependencies or generated-file changes); R-5 satisfied (test/math.test.mjs:85,88 both use the range prefix).
Finding LOW at test/math.test.mjs:85-90: the two new tests omit validation errors and input preservation, leaving those specified behaviors without durable regression coverage despite the implementation currently satisfying them; smallest verification is to add range-prefixed assertions for empty input, nonarrays, invalid/nonfinite elements and unchanged input, then rerun the isolated range check.
Checks actually run: git rev-parse HEAD matched; node --test --test-name-pattern="^range" test/ exited 0 with "tests 2", "pass 2", "fail 0"; npm test exited 1 with "tests 17", "pass 16", "fail 1" and sole failure "clamp respects upper bound" at test/math.test.mjs:13 (15 !== 10), which is unchanged and explicitly expected; supplementary read-only node assertions exited 0 with "PASS supplemental: 7 shape rejections, 1 empty rejection, 12 invalid-element/sparse rejections, 6 numeric/nonmutation cases" (the initial heredoc invocation was blocked before execution, then rerun using node -e); remaining uncertainty is limited to cases beyond those inspected/exercised, and no files were modified.
